jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Data & AI)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

foodpanda is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

 **Job Description**

We are looking for a **Senior Software Engineer (Data & AI)** to design, build, and scale production AI applications and agentic systems that solve complex operational and analytical challenges across foodpanda’s footprint in APAC and Europe.

In this role, applied AI takes center stage—grounded by robust data infrastructure. While your primary focus will be architecting agentic workflows, advanced RAG systems, and intelligent automations, you will also design, build, and maintain the underlying data pipelines that feed these systems. You will take full end-to-end ownership of the stack: ensuring data quality and pipeline performance, orchestrating agent behaviors, and actively participating in the team’s production on-call rotation to keep our services reliable and resilient.

An initiative within the team is our **agentic analytics platform**, which connects AI agents directly with our enterprise business logic, semantic layers, and context engines to deliver accurate, verifiable insights.

**Responsibilities**

* **Deliver End-to-End AI Applications:** Design, build, and maintain production AI applications, including agentic workflows, RAG systems, and integrations with business knowledge, semantic layers, and external tools. Build solutions that go beyond prototypes and deliver measurable value to users.
* **Practice Evaluation-Driven Development:** Build and maintain evaluations to measure the correctness, reliability, and effectiveness of AI applications. Leverage evaluation datasets, automated testing, production observability, and user feedback to understand failure modes and continuously improve system behavior.
* **Iterate Closely with Stakeholders:** Partner directly with analytics and business teams to understand their workflows, challenge assumptions, and translate ambiguous problems into practical solutions. Rapidly prototype, validate ideas, and refine products based on real-world feedback.
* **Own Software End-to-End:** Take ownership across the software lifecycle, from technical discovery and architecture to implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Be comfortable working across data infrastructure, backend services, and user-facing applications where needed.
* **Balance Speed with Engineering Discipline:** Leverage modern development tools, including AI coding agents, to accelerate delivery while maintaining high standards for software design, automated verification, security, and maintainability.
* **Contribute to Engineering Excellence:** Drive technical design discussions, contribute to architectural decisions and RFCs, participate in code reviews and pair programming, and mentor other engineers through knowledge sharing and collaboration.
* **Maintain Production Reliability:** Take responsibility for the systems you build and maintain, including observability, incident investigation, performance optimization, and participation in the team’s on-call rotation.
* **Build and Own Data & Context Pipelines:** Design, build, and maintain the ingestion, ETL/ELT, and context-retrieval pipelines that feed our AI models, semantic layers, and agentic workflows. Take shared ownership of pipeline reliability, data freshness, and incident response as an active participant in the team's production on-call rotation

  
**Qualifications**  

* **Strong Software Engineering Fundamentals:** You have 7+ years of software engineering experience, with strong proficiency in Python, SQL, system design, and automated testing. You enjoy building reliable, maintainable production systems.
* **Applied AI Experience:** You’ve developed LLM-powered applications, agentic workflows, or related systems, and understand the challenges of taking AI solutions from experimentation into production.
* **AI Evaluation & Observability:** You’ve built evaluation datasets, frameworks, or automated harnesses to systematically measure and improve AI application performance, or have experience with observability tools such as Langfuse.
* **Engineering and Product Judgment:** You have informed opinions about how AI systems should behave. You know when to use LLMs, when deterministic software is more appropriate, and how to balance correctness, complexity, cost, and user experience.
* **Curiosity and Technical Awareness:** You stay informed about emerging AI research, models, agent architectures, and software engineering practices. You enjoy experimenting with new ideas while remaining pragmatic about what delivers value.
* **Ownership and Product Mindset:** You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, working directly with stakeholders, and making thoughtful decisions when there isn’t a single right answer. You care about the experience of the people using your software.
* **Pragmatic Engineering Approach:** You enjoy shipping quickly to learn, but don’t compromise user trust, software reliability, or maintainability in the process. You value evidence, testing, and continuous improvement.
* **Collaborative Mindset:** You enjoy working with other engineers through technical discussions, pair programming, code reviews, and mentorship.

**Good to have:**

* **Hands-on Data Engineering Experience:** You’ve built and maintained production data pipelines, data integrations, or data-intensive systems, and understand the importance of data quality, modeling, and operational reliability.
* **Modern Data Platforms:** You’ve worked with technologies such as BigQuery, dbt, Apache Airflow, PySpark, or lake house architectures.
* **Knowledge & Semantic Systems:** You’ve built applications integrating LLMs with structured data, semantic layers (dbtflow, cube), knowledge graphs, context engineering, or retrieval systems.
* **Cloud & DevOps:** You have experience with AWS or GCP, Docker, and automated CI/CD pipelines.
* **Full-Stack Product Development:** You’ve shipped product features end-to-end and are comfortable working across frontend, backend, and model integrations.
* **Developer Experience:** You’ve built internal platforms, developer tools, or infrastructure that improve how other engineers build, test, or operate software.

  
**Additional Information**

**What we can feed you:**

* A collaborative, international engineering team working on challenging problems across data infrastructure and applied AI.
* Opportunities to own meaningful projects end-to-end, from early ideas to production systems used by business teams.
* A culture of technical learning, experimentation, knowledge sharing, and professional development.
* Regular company and team events, with a commitment to diversity and inclusion.
* Benefits include free food, health and dental insurance, and learning and development opportunities.

foodpanda is proud to be a company that believes in diversity and representation as key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. We hire people based on merit and qualifications and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or any other aspect that makes you, you. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let your Talent Acquisition partner know.

To all recruitment agencies: foodpanda does not accept third-party resumes. Please do not send resumes to our jobs alias, foodpanda employees, or any other organization location. foodpanda is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

* Programming experience in a relevant language
* Demonstrated experience driving change within an organization and leading complex technical projects
* Experience utilizing data and analysis to explain technical problems and provide detailed feedback and solutions

* Experience setting engineering standards for AI-native engineering practices
* Experience improving quality through thoughtful code reviews, appropriate testing, proper rollout, monitoring, and proactive changes

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. jobs.title: SENIOR STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER
jobs.description:
About the Company
  
  
Prodigy is a Singapore-headquartered technology company specializing in 3D game engine development, game creation tools, and User-Generated Content (UGC) platform operations. The Company develops and operates a proprietary game editor platform that enables creators to build, share, and publish interactive digital experiences within a growing creator ecosystem.
  
  
With over 1 million cumulative downloads and an active global creator community, the Company continues to invest in platform innovation, creator productivity tools, and AI-assisted technologies that enhance content creation workflows, user experience, and platform capabilities.
  
  
Senior Software Engineer AI Platform and3D Systems
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Senior Software Engineer is a hands-on technical role responsible for designing and delivering production software that supports the Company's creator platform and AI-assisted content creation workflows.
  
  
Reporting to the Engineering Research Manager, the role covers performance-critical C/C++ components, back-end and integration services, AI model and agent integration, and the reliability of production systems.
  
  
Working closely with product, editor, graphics, and platform teams, the Senior Software Engineer will convert approved technical approaches into reliable product features while contributing practical technical guidance and hands-on implementation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Software Architecture and Delivery
  
  

* Deliver assigned software projects through requirements analysis, technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance.
* Design scalable and maintainable components in line with the technical roadmap, architecture direction, and engineering standards established by the Engineering Research Manager.
* Translate product requirements into practical technical solutions and document key design choices, interfaces, dependencies, and operational considerations.
* Recommend technology and system design choices, and escalate material architecture, security, delivery, and resource decisions to the Engineering Research Manager.
* Maintain automated tests, conduct code reviews, and support reliable release and maintenance processes for the components under the role's responsibility.

AI Assisted Product Engineering
  
  

* Prototype, evaluate, and implement approved AI-assisted capabilities for authoring, asset, and content workflows.
* Build Python or Node.js back-end, integration, and automation services that connect product workflows to approved large language models, AI agents, and external AI services.
* Develop evaluation and telemetry mechanisms to measure functional quality, reliability, latency, and compute cost.
* Implement controlled interfaces for external AI resource-generation services, including appropriate error handling, security, privacy, and usage controls.
* Work with product and engineering colleagues to move validated prototypes into maintainable production features.

3D and Performance Critical Systems
  
  

* Design and build performance-critical C/C++ components for editor, platform, and interactive 3D content workflows.
* Develop or integrate modules for image processing, computer vision, 3D data processing, visualization, or related creator-tool capabilities where required by the product.
* Support the translation of natural-language and component-based instructions into dependable editor and platform actions.
* Benchmark and optimise relevant implementations for generation performance, responsiveness, memory use, and stability.
* Collaborate with the Company's editor, graphics, and game-engine engineers to integrate new capabilities without disrupting established 3D and platform systems.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and tune production systems, and conduct structured root-cause analysis for material incidents.

Technical Collaboration and Mentoring
  
  

* Provide technical guidance, code-review feedback, and practical support to other engineers working on related modules.
* Coordinate project-level technical work and communicate delivery progress, dependencies, and technical risks to the Engineering Research Manager.
* Work closely with product managers and engineering colleagues to clarify requirements, sequence implementation work, and resolve delivery issues.
* Contribute to engineering documentation, shared practices, and continuous improvement while remaining an individual contributor with no direct reports initially.

Job Requirements
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum 8 years of professional software development experience, including responsibility for the design and delivery of production systems.
* Strong programming skills in C or C++and practical experience with Python or Node.js.
* Experience designing, building, and troubleshooting distributed, high-concurrency, or other performance-sensitive production systems.
* Strong knowledge of software architecture, data structures, networking, concurrency, testing, and software engineering best practices.
* Experience delivering software through technical design, implementation, code review, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance.
* Ability to analyse complex technical problems, compare implementation options, and explain recommendations and trade-offs clearly.
* Experience working with product and engineering teams to convert requirements into maintainable technical solutions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team.
* Ability to work within an established technical roadmap while taking ownership of assigned modules and delivery commitments.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience integrating Large Language Models, AI agents, multimodal systems, or third-party AI services into production products.
* Experience designing evaluations, telemetry, or quality controls for AI-assisted product features.
* Experience with OpenGL, OpenCV, computer vision, 3D data, interactive editors, game engines, or related technologies.
* Experience developing creator tools, content creation workflows, UGC platforms, or other interactive software products.
* Experience improving system performance, reliability, observability, latency, or infrastructure cost.
* Experience operating software across Windows, macOS, Linux, cloud, or containerised environments.
* Experience mentoring engineers or coordinating the technical delivery of a project.
* Master's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field.

Reporting Line
  
  
Reports directly to the Engineering Research Manager and works closely with product, editor, graphics, platform, and other engineering teams. The role is a hands-on individual-contributor position with project-level technical leadership responsibilities and no direct reports initially.

jobs.title: AI Product Engineer (Fullstack)
jobs.description:
The Role
  
  
We're looking for an
  
  
AI Product Engineer
  
  
who wants to own real product problems end to end.
  
  
We don't separate product engineering from customer problems. Engineers stay close to users and face their real business problems rather than optimize technology in isolation. You might start by understanding a workflow, ingesting and structuring the customer's context, shaping the experience, building across the stack, improving an agent or integration, shipping it, and learning from real use.
  
  
You do not need to be an expert in everything. We are building a team of
  
  
T-shaped engineers
  
  
: broad enough to own a product experience end to end, with meaningful depth in at least one area such as frontend, backend, mobile, data, AI systems, infrastructure, or integrations.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Own product features end to end.
  
  
Go from discovery and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, operation, and iteration.
  
  
Build production AI systems.
  
  
Create agents that use tools and customer context to complete real business workflows, learn through feedback loops and long-term memory, and become more useful over time, supported by practical evaluation and observability.
  
  
Connect AI to real business systems.
  
  
Build reliable integrations and data flows across advertising, social media platforms, CRM, analytics, payments, and other platforms.
  
  
Work directly with customers.
  
  
Understand their business, workflow, technology stack, and pain points instead of receiving every problem through layers of abstraction.
  
  
Turn recurring pain into product.
  
  
When onboarding, data ingestion, an integration, or an AI output is consistently slow, low-quality, or unreliable, find the underlying product, architecture, or agent problem and make the system better for the next hundred customers.
  
  
Who You Are
  
  
You have strong software engineering fundamentals and experience shipping and operating real production systems. More importantly:
  
  
You can take an ambiguous problem, investigate it deeply, create structure, and own it through to a working outcome.
  
  
You are comfortable crossing technical boundaries and learning whatever the problem requires.
  
  
You have meaningful depth in at least one technical area and enough breadth to collaborate across the rest of the product.
  
  
You care whether what you build creates a useful customer outcome, not only whether the implementation works.
  
  
You use AI throughout your engineering workflow to research, prototype, write, review, test, debug, and learn, while exercising judgment about the quality of its output.
  
  
You understand that production agent engineering is more than prompting and are interested in the systems around the model: tools, context, retrieval, evaluation, state, reliability, and user interaction.
  
  
You communicate openly and are comfortable collaborating with customers, product managers, designers, and other engineers.
  
  
Bonus Points
  
  
You do not need all of these. We are especially interested if you have depth in one or more of the following:
  
  
You have shipped an LLM- or agent-powered product used by real customers.
  
  
You have hands-on experience with agent evaluation, tool use, retrieval, long-running workflows, or agent infrastructure.
  
  
You have built large-scale data ingestion or synchronization systems.
  
  
You have integrated advertising, social media, CRM, analytics, payment, or other business platforms.
  
  
You have worked directly with customers in product engineering, forward-deployed engineering, solutions engineering, consulting, or an agency.
  
  
You understand marketing workflows, marketing technology, or how businesses acquire and engage customers.
  
  
Why Join Us
  
  
You will have genuine ownership of both the product and the technology behind it. You will work closely with users and leadership, see the impact of what you build, and have the freedom to challenge how things currently work.
  
  
You will not be adding a chatbot to the edge of an established product. You will be building products where agents, context, tools, data, integrations, and user experience are all part of the core architecture.
  
  
Our culture is different from a typical software company. We grew from content creation, so we combine engineering rigor with storytelling, speed, experimentation, and a desire to make things people care about. The team shares ownership and passion for the company's success. You grow quickly, build close friendships, and find meaning in creating something ambitious together.

jobs.description:
**C++ Software Engineer**
=========================

**Hybrid (Singapore-based) | Full-Time**

**About Us**
------------

Reactive Markets is the **2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year** (Risk.net). Our network handles over $75 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 60+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

**The Role**
------------

We're looking for a C++ Software Engineer who wants to build low-latency trading infrastructure on Linux. You'll work on the core components of our Switchboard trading platform — pricing engines, connectivity gateways, market-data systems, and the messaging layer that ties them together.

This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall. You build it, you test it, you deploy it, you support it in production, and you improve it. Our engineers own the full lifecycle — from design through to operational excellence. When something breaks at 4pm on a Friday, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

**What You'll Work On**
-----------------------

* Modern C++20 and Go on Linux — a modern software stack based on open source
* Cloud-native infrastructure on AWS with colocation in key data centres
* Microsecond-level latency optimisation and high-throughput messaging
* Market-data and reference-data pipelines across multiple asset classes
* FIX protocol integrations with global banks and liquidity providers
* Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make system behaviour visible
* Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

**What We Need**
----------------

**Technical:**

* Strong C++ with Linux systems programming (3+ years)
* Comfortable working close to the metal — you understand what's underneath your code
* Experience with performance-sensitive systems (profiling, optimisation, deterministic behaviour)
* Familiarity with networking fundamentals (TCP/UDP, socket programming)
* Go experience is a strong bonus — we use Go extensively for microservices and command-line tooling, and you'll be expected to work with it internally. If you don't know it yet, strong C++ engineers pick it up quickly
* Python for scripting, automation, testing, and data analysis — used across the platform for tooling and operational workflows
* Git and shell scripting
* Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

**How you work:**

* **You ship.** You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production
* **You own it.** When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop
* **You write things down.** Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist
* **You communicate.** We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential
* **You care about quality.** You write clean, testable code. You review your peers' work thoughtfully. You push for continuous improvement without gold-plating
* **You embrace AI tooling.** We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

**What You Get**
----------------

* **Real problems** —trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks
* **An excellent team** — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards
* **Ownership** — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients
* **Competitive package** — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites
* **Remote-friendly** — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver
* **Sustainable pace** — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp
* **Growth** — career progression to senior roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

**Our Hiring Process**
----------------------

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

**Stage 1: Initial Conversation** with Talent Acquisition  
Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

**Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation** with the relevant team lead or hiring manager  
Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

**Stage 3: Technical Interview** with two members of the relevant engineering team  
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

**Stage 4: In-person Interview** with the Head of our Singapore office to see the environment and meet some of the team  
Format: In-person ~45 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

* Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

**How to Apply**
----------------

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

**Right to Work:** Candidates must have the existing right to work in Singapore. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, iOS
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
**About Grab and Our Workplace**
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Get to Know the Team**
The Partner Apps Platform team enables internal and external teams to create, onboard, operate and scale web apps across Grab. We own the developer tooling, self-service capabilities, developer portal, backend platform and reliability foundations that make PArtner Apps delivery safe, observable and efficient.
  
  
**Get to Know the Role**
As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you will shape and build platform capabilities that simplify how Partner apps are onboarded, configured, reviewed, released and operated. You will work across the developer portal, webview javascript-bridge and backend services, lead technical decisions and help the team turn complex platform workflows into reliable self-service experiences.
  
  
You will be reporting to Software Engineering manager II
  
  
**The Critical Tasks You Will Perform**

* Design, build, and maintain iOS SDK capabilities, native entry points, JavaScript bridges, and reusable APIs for Partner Apps.
* Improve SDK reliability, performance, security, observability, and backward compatibility across Grab app releases.
* Drive iOS capability parity by defining clear cross-platform contracts and consistent developer experiences.
* Partner with backend engineers on authentication, API, SDK scopes, transaction capabilities, telemetry, and other platform integrations.
* Build automated tests, release tooling, sample applications, and technical documentation that make partner integrations faster and safer.
* Investigate production issues, strengthen monitoring and failure handling, and contribute to incident response and post-incident improvements.
* Collaborate with product, design, QA, and partner teams to translate requirements into scalable mobile platform solutions.
* Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and continuous improvement of engineering standards.

**Qualifications**
**What Essential Skills You Will Need**

* At least 5 years of professional iOS development experience, with proficiency in Swift and the iOS SDK.
* Experience designing or maintaining mobile SDKs, frameworks, libraries, or platform components used by multiple product teams.
* Knowledge of iOS application architecture, lifecycle, concurrency, networking and performance optimisation.
* Experience with WKWebView-based integrations, JavaScript bridges, RESTful APIs, and secure client-server communication.
* Understanding of API design, versioning, backward compatibility, testing strategy, and release management.
* Hands-on experience with XCTest, unit and integration testing, and CI/CD for iOS applications, frameworks, or SDKs.
* Diagnose complex production issues using logs, metrics, traces, Instruments, and systematic debugging techniques.
* Collaboration with experience working across mobile, backend, QA, product, and external partner teams.
* Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction through architecture and high-quality code.
* Experience with UIKit, SwiftUI, mobile security, observability, developer tooling, or large-scale platform ecosystems is an advantage.

**Additional Information**
**Life at Grab**
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
  
  

* We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
* With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
* Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
* We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
* Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

**What We Stand For At Grab**
We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.
